categories.main_business_segments: Korea United Pharm Inc. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales sector, focusing on prescription drugs. The company specializes in improved new drugs (incremental innovations) and has developed 14 such products, including blockbuster drugs like Silostan CR, Artmac Combi Zel, and Gastin CR. It also engages in angel investment and startup incubation to diversify its business portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical R&D and manufacturing technologies, including chemical synthesis for improved new drugs and generic formulations. It operates KGMP and cGMP-compliant production facilities with smart factory systems for solid and injectable formulations, including specialized plants for anticancer drugs and inhalers. R&D investment exceeds 11% of sales, supporting continuous innovation and product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Korea United Pharm serves hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and government institutions domestically, with a sales network covering all medical institutions nationwide. Internationally, it exports finished pharmaceuticals to over 40 countries, including Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the US, China, Russia, and Southeast Asia. Its customer base includes wholesalers, public and private hospitals, and overseas buyers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with headquarters and production facilities in Sejong City and Seoul. It exports products globally to more than 40 countries across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. It has licensing and distribution agreements in countries such as Russia, China, the US, and Thailand, and plans to expand overseas production and sales through local subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Korea United Pharm operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug formulation, manufacturing, and sales. It sources raw materials domestically and internationally but primarily adds value through drug development and production. The company also licenses out technologies and finished products to global partners, indicating a role in both manufacturing and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in improved new drugs and novel formulations, maintaining an R&D-to-sales ratio above 11%. It focuses on cardiovascular, digestive, respiratory, and anticancer therapeutic areas, with ongoing clinical trials for several chemical synthesis-based new drugs. Strategic initiatives include global licensing, technology export, startup incubation, and collaboration with academic institutions for innovative drug development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products domestically and internationally. The company also earns licensing fees and milestone payments from license-out agreements with global pharmaceutical companies. Sales channels include direct sales to medical institutions, wholesalers, government tenders, and export contracts with overseas buyers, using various payment methods such as cash, letters of credit, and trade terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly fragmented Korean pharmaceutical market with approximately 400 domestic manufacturers. It positions itself as a leading specialty pharmaceutical company with a strong focus on improved new drugs and R&D capabilities. Its competitive advantages include a robust product portfolio, high R&D investment, and global licensing partnerships, differentiating it from generic-focused competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Korea United Pharm reported 2023 revenues of approximately KRW 278.9 billion, representing a 6.3% year-over-year increase, with operating profit of KRW 54.95 billion (+14%) and net income of KRW 48.26 billion (+6.6%). Total assets grew 12.2% to KRW 468.9 billion, and equity increased 12.1% to KRW 378.7 billion. The company maintains a stable financial position with a low debt ratio (~24%) and strong liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its high-quality improved new drugs developed through advanced R&D and proprietary technologies, offering enhanced efficacy and patient compliance. Its value proposition includes a diversified product portfolio with blockbuster drugs, strong manufacturing capabilities with smart factories, and global licensing partnerships that expand market reach. Continuous innovation and strategic investments in new drug development underpin its competitive differentiation.
